summary: 牛科动物在体型和栖息地上相差极大，却有反刍、分蹄等共同特征。文章借牛、羚羊、山羊、非洲小羚羊和叉角羚等类群，说明它们如何适应草地、山地及其他环境。
logic: 交代牛科分布与体型跨度
比较各类群的栖息地与食性
观察叉角羚的群体警戒

paragraphs.brief: 哺乳动物的家族叫做bovids，属于亚丁基类，也包括长颈鹿。
sentences: The family of mammals called bovids belongs to the Artiodactyl class, which also includes giraffes.
哺乳动物的家族叫做bovids，属于亚丁基类，也包括长颈鹿。
Bovids are a highly diverse group consisting of 137 species, some of which are man’s most important domestic animals.
博维德是高度多样化的种群，由137种物种组成，其中一些是人类最重要的家畜。

paragraphs.brief: 欧亚岛和东南亚岛的大部分地区都有博维德人，但他们是后者中人数最多、种类最多的岛屿。
sentences: Bovids are well represented in most parts of Eurasia and Southeast Asian islands, but they are by far the most numerous and diverse in the latter.
欧亚岛和东南亚岛的大部分地区都有博维德人，但他们是后者中人数最多、种类最多的岛屿。
Some species of bovid are solitary, but others live in large groups with complex social structures.
有些动物是孤独的，但另一些则生活在社会结构复杂的大群体中。
Although bovids have adapted to a wide range of habitats, from arctic tundra to deep tropical forest, the majority of species favour open grassland, scrub or desert.
虽然动物已经适应了从北极苔原到深热带森林等广泛的生境，但大多数物种倾向于开阔草地、清洗或沙漠。

This diversity of habitat is also matched by great diversity in size and form: at one extreme is the royal antelope of West Africa, which stands a mere 25 cm at the shoulder; at the other, the massively built bison of North America and Europe, growing to a shoulder height of 2.2m.
这种生境的多样性在规模和形式上也具有极大的多样性：一个极端是西非的皇室羚羊，肩上只有25厘米；另一个极端是北美和欧洲的大型野牛，肩上高度为220米。

paragraphs.brief: 雄性动物和雌性动物都有双蹄和双蹄
sentences: Despite differences in size and appearance, bovids are united by the possession of certain common features.
尽管在大小和外表上存在差异，但由于拥有某些共同特征，僵尸会团结起来。
All species are ruminants, which means that they retain undigested food in their stomachs, and regurgitate it as necessary.
所有物种都是反胃动物，这意味着它们将未消化的食物保留在胃里，必要时再加营养。
Bovids are almost exclusively herbivorous.
食肉动物几乎都是食草动物

Typically, their teeth are highly modified for browsing and grazing: grass or foliage is cropped with the upper lip and lower incisors (the upper incisors are usually absent), and then ground down by the cheek teeth.
通常，他们的牙齿为浏览和放牧而作高度改装：草或树叶用上唇和下切口(通常没有上切口)耕种，然后用脸颊牙倒地。
As well as having cloven, or split hooves, the males of all bovid species and the females of most carry horns.
雄性动物和雌性动物都有双蹄和双蹄
Bovid horns have bony cores covered in a sheath of horny material that is constantly renewed from within; they are unbranched and never shed.
波维德角有骨心覆盖在从内部不断更新的角质材料堆中它们被拔除，从不脱落

They vary in shape and size: the relatively simple horns of a large Indian buffalo may measure around 4 m from tip to tip along the outer curve, while the various gazelles have horns with a variety of elegant curves.
它们的形式和大小各不相同：大型印度水牛的相对简单的角从尖到尖大约4米，沿着外曲线，而不同的瞪羚有角，有各种优雅的曲线。

paragraphs.brief: 5个群体或次家庭可分为：博维纳、安特洛普、卡普里纳、切帕洛菲纳和安蒂洛卡普里达。
sentences: Five groups, or sub-families, may be distinguished: Bovinae, Antelope, Caprinae, Cephalophinae and Antilocapridae.
5个群体或次家庭可分为：博维纳、安特洛普、卡普里纳、切帕洛菲纳和安蒂洛卡普里达。
The sub-family Bovinae comprises most of the larger bovids, including the African bongo, nilgai, eland, bison and cattle.
波维纳子家庭包括大多数较大的牲畜，包括非洲邦戈、零盖、电子、野牛和牛。
Unlike most other bovids, they are all non-territorial.
与大多数其他法例不同，它们都是非属地的。

The ancestors of the various species of domestic cattle (such as banteng, gaur, yak and water buffalo) are generally rare and endangered in the wild, while the auroch (the ancestor of the domestic cattle of Europe) is extinct.
各种家畜的祖先(如班滕、毛革、牛和水牛)通常很少见，在野外濒临灭绝，而农牧业(欧洲家畜的祖辈)则灭绝。

paragraphs.brief: 羚羊一般是长腿、快速的物种，通常在动物全面飞行时，长角可以沿背部放置。
sentences: The term ‘antelope’ is not a very precise zoological name – it is used to loosely describe a number of bovids that have followed different lines of development.
“antelope”一词并不是一个非常精确的动物学名称，它被用来粗略地描述一些遵循不同发展线的“bovid”。
Antelopes are typically long-legged, fast-running species, often with long horns that may be laid along the back when the animal is in full flight.
羚羊一般是长腿、快速的物种，通常在动物全面飞行时，长角可以沿背部放置。

There are two main sub-groups of antelope: Hippotraginae, which includes the oryx and the addax, and Antilopinae, which generally contains slighter and more graceful animals such as gazelle and the springbok.
羚羊主要分为两大组：和安提洛维纳，前者包括和，后者一般含有较轻和优雅的动物，如瞪羚和弹簧虫。

Antelopes are mainly grassland species, but many have adapted to flooded grasslands: pukus, waterbucks and lechwes are all good at swimming, usually feeding in deep water, while the sitatunga has long, splayed hooves that enable it to walk freely on swampy ground.
羚羊主要是草原物种，但许多动物已经适应了被淹没的草地：猪群、水桶和鱼都擅长游泳，通常在深水中进食，而鱼则长长的、弹奏的蹄子可以让它在沼泽的土地上自由行走。

paragraphs.brief: 卡普里纳小家庭包括绵羊和山羊，以及诸如大公和大公等各种亲属。
sentences: The sub-family Caprinae includes the sheep and the goat, together with various relatives such as the goral and the tahr.
卡普里纳小家庭包括绵羊和山羊，以及诸如大公和大公等各种亲属。
Most are woolly or have long hair.
大部分是毛毛或长发。
Several species, such as wild goats, chamois and ibex, are agile cliff and mountain-dwellers.
一些物种，如野羊、沙米瓦和伊布克斯，是敏捷的悬崖和山地居民。

Tolerance of extreme conditions is most marked in this group: barbary and bighorn sheep have adapted to arid deserts, while Rocky Mountain sheep survive high up in mountains and musk oxen in arctic tundra.
容忍极端情况在这类人中最为明显：野羊和大角羊适应了干旱的沙漠，而落基山羊在高山中生存，而牛在北极苔原中生存。

paragraphs.brief: 非洲的骗子属于Cephalophinae子家庭。
sentences: The duiker of Africa belongs to the Cephalophinae sub-family.
非洲的骗子属于Cephalophinae子家庭。
It is generally small and solitary, often living in thick forest.
它一般很小，而且很孤独，往往生活在茂密的森林中。
Although mainly feeding on grass and leaves, some duikers – unlike most other bovids – are believed to eat insects and feed on dead animal carcasses, and even to kill small animals.
虽然有些杜克人主要靠草和树叶为生，但与其他大多数野生动物不同，他们相信他们吃昆虫，吃死动物的肉，甚至杀死小动物。

paragraphs.brief: 长角鱼是新世界的食草动物小家族北美的安提洛卡普里达的唯一幸存者
sentences: The pronghorn is the sole survivor of a New World sub-family of herbivorous ruminants, the Antilocapridae in North America.
长角鱼是新世界的食草动物小家族北美的安提洛卡普里达的唯一幸存者
It is similar in appearance and habits to the Old World antelope.
它在外表和习惯上与旧世界的羚羊相似。

Although greatly reduced in numbers since the arrival of Europeans, and the subsequent enclosure of grasslands, the pronghorn is still found in considerable numbers throughout North America, from Washington State to Mexico.
虽然在欧洲人抵达以及随后的草地被封闭之后，人数大大减少，但从华盛顿州到墨西哥，北美各地仍然有大量长角动物。
When alarmed by the approach of wolves or other predators, hairs on the pronghorn’s rump stand erect, so showing and emphasising the white patch there.
当对狼群或其他掠食者的接近感到惊恐时，长角的长发竖立起来，从而显示和强调那里的白色斑点。
At this signal, the whole herd gallops off at speed of over 60 km per hour.
在这个信号下整个群群以每小时60公里的速度飞速起飞

groups.label: 简答题
groups.instructionsZh: 根据原文简答。每题最多填三个词。

pairs: 第 3 段 · 第 5 句
points: 题干问“通常可以快速移动”。定位句写到“羚羊一般是长腿、快速的物种，通常在动物全面飞行时，长角可以沿背部放置”。
正确选项 D 的意思是“开阔的空间”。原文对应的是“虽然动物已经适应了从北极苔原到深热带森林等广泛的生境，但大多数物种倾向于开阔草地、清洗或沙漠”。
clauses: “which means that they retain undigested food in their stomachs, and regurgitate it as necessary”修饰前面的 ruminants。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 ruminants，再把修饰信息接回主句。
They vary in shape and size: the relatively simple horns of a large Indian buffalo may measure around 4 m from tip to tip along the outer curve, ….
连接词 while 引出“while the various gazelles have horns with a variety of elegant curves”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
